tips: 💡 Pay yourself first — save before you spend.
🎯 Follow the 50-30-20 rule: needs, wants, savings.
📝 Track every expense for one week — it changes everything.
🛒 Wait 24 hours before any non-essential purchase.
💰 Small savings today become big security tomorrow.
🚫 A budget is telling your money where to go.
📈 Review your budget every month — adjust and improve.
